name: nextcart-search-fix
description: Condensed from a real live NextCart session (final_nc_1219732343, saved verbatim under server/sessions/samples/final_nc_1219732343.json) — a POSITIVE case: the model correctly fired a search_help card off a misspelled zero-result search ("bluetoth headphnes" -> 0 results, 3 real fuzzy candidates). Two live defects this fixture now regression-covers: (1) grammar — the live card's body read "Found 3 match for Pulsegear..." (server/prompts/templates.json's {count|match|matches} pluralization fix); (2) NextCart's search box carries data-agent-target="search-input", not the "search" id server/store/index.js's search_help offer hardcodes as target_hint — the live model worked around this itself by picking the lookalike visible target directly (a rule violation policy.js never caught, since it doesn't cross-check target against offers[].target_hint); the anchor-fallback fix now makes this deterministic instead of luck-dependent, rewriting target_hint "search" to "cart-link" (universally present) since "search" itself is never a real NextCart target. 3 candidates -> cta.kind stays "search" (only exactly 1 candidate switches to open_product, per prompts/decide.md's updated Failed search recipe) — not independently exercised here, see sessions/search-open-product.json for that branch.
